summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require petrol sold at the bowser to contain a minimum percentage of renewable fuel.
It would set a minimum renewable fuel content of 5% from 1 July 2019 and 10% from 1 July 2022, and create an Office of Renewable Fuel Program Administrator.
The explanatory memorandum says the mandate would reduce emissions, create jobs, and increase fuel self-sufficiency, but does not specify which Acts are amended.
changes: Mandates a minimum 5% renewable fuel content in petrol from 1 July 2019.
Mandates a minimum 10% renewable fuel content from 1 July 2022.
Establishes an Office of Renewable Fuel Program Administrator.
Outlines the functions of the Office of Renewable Fuel Program Administrator.
Provides a regulatory regime for cellulosic biomass ethanol and other renewable fuels in motor vehicle fuel.
summary.affected: Suppliers of petrol for use in motor vehicles in Australia, and consumers who buy petrol at the bowser.
